description: Scenario: server carries a large group set (millions of articles). store/article_numbers.rs::list_all_articles executes SELECT group_name, article_number, cid FROM article_numbers ORDER BY group_name, article_number and fetches all rows into a Vec<Row> in one call. On a server with 10M articles this allocates several hundred MB on startup for the backfill pass. No pagination or streaming is available. A server with insufficient RAM will OOM before reaching the listen loop.
title: list_all_articles loads entire article dataset into memory
